headline: Failed House resolution would have directed the President to remove U.S. troops from hostilities in Lebanon within seven days.
what_it_does: This resolution would have used the War Powers Resolution to direct the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities in Lebanon within seven days of its adoption. It stated that it would not stop or limit U.S. security cooperation with the Lebanese Armed Forces. It also would not have prevented the protection of U.S. diplomatic facilities. The House voted it down on June 30, 2026.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. service members involved in hostilities in Lebanon
who_it_affects.how: They would have been removed from those hostilities within seven days of the resolution's adoption.
The President would have been directed by Congress to end U.S. military involvement in hostilities in Lebanon.
Security cooperation with the United States would have been allowed to continue under the resolution.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. diplomats and embassy staff in Lebanon
who_it_affects.how: U.S. forces would still have been allowed to protect diplomatic facilities.
